items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Blockchain is perfect solution for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
items.summary: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.

items.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
items.summary: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure but skeptics have their doubts.

items.title: Trumps memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
items.summary: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

items.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
items.summary: Thailands SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitgets operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

items.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
items.summary: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

items.title: Sam Altman Says It's 'Fucking Annoying' His RAM Comments Were Taken Out of Context
items.summary: The OpenAI CEO briefly renamed himself Ram Altman on X after Elon Musk mocked him for saying idle home PC memory is quite terrible.

items.title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
items.summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?

items.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
items.summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

items.title: Binance Cuts Off SignalPlus API Keys Over 'Potential Security Issue' at Trading Platform
items.summary: The exchange said its own systems and user funds are unaffected, a week after it lost $6.4 billion in a hack blamed on North Korea.

items.title: Canadian Man Extradited to US Over Plot to Hijack University Supercomputers for Crypto
items.summary: Prosecutors say Ryan Roach and a co-defendant targeted U.S. universities with supercomputers, stealing logins and secretly mining crypto.

items.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
items.summary: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on whether the Razorbacks win or lose is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

items.title: Samsung Wallet launches USDC accounts on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.summary: Samsung Wallet's Stablecoin Account is now live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, allowing them to use USDC on Solana.

items.title: Eric Trumps American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit in Q3 on digital asset gains

items.title: Arkansas sues Kalshi, says its alleged illegal gambling operations cause mental harm
items.summary: The lawsuit adds Arkansas to a growing list of states taking legal action against the prediction market platform.

items.title: The Digital Chamber calls Sherrod Browns win most consequential unfavorable result for crypto
items.summary: Democrats are set to reorient the crypto policy debate toward stronger consumer protections and regulatory accountability, the group said.

items.title: Crdit Mutuel Arka confirms cyberattack after ZachXBT flags $133M in suspected losses

items.title: Democratic sweep of Congress forces crypto industry to rethink Washington strategy
